A detail-oriented cloud and DevOps engineer focused on automation, infrastructure as code, and reliable CI/CD pipelines.

Azure DevOps Engineer, GreenGrid
Nov 2025 - Present
Led platform automation for a renewable-energy telemetry platform, delivering automated build-and-deploy pipelines that reduced release time by 45%. Implemented containerized build agents and standard container images for microservices, enabling consistent deployments across environments. Built Ansible playbooks to configure and patch Linux hosts and integrated Docker-based services into Azure Container Instances for staging. Collaborated with product and QA teams using Confluence and Jira to track releases and incidents.

Cloud Engineer, Saffron Bank
May 2024 - Oct 2025
Designed and maintained Kubernetes clusters for a digital payments product, improving availability and scaling to handle 3x peak loads. Containerized legacy services with Docker and migrated workloads onto K8s with declarative manifests and Helm charts. Automated provisioning of Azure resources using Terraform and wrote PowerShell scripts for routine operational tasks on Linux-based VMs. Participated in Agile ceremonies and documented runbooks in Confluence.

Azure DevOps Engineer, CartNest
Feb 2022 - Apr 2024
Owned CI/CD pipelines for an e-commerce platform, standardizing Docker image builds and implementing image scanning as part of CI. Automated configuration management with Ansible to deploy application stacks onto Linux servers and reduced configuration drift. Implemented Terraform modules for repeatable environment provisioning in Azure and created PowerShell scripts for deployment orchestration. Tracked work and sprints using Jira and maintained technical documentation in Confluence.

Skills:
Microsoft Azure, Terraform, K8s, Docker, PowerShell, Ansible, Linux, Agile, Confluence, Jira
